source: #1050, event 864556, 2026-11-19 17:41 PST (Josh: "Why is this parked but still listed in Build 4? is it done or not?" at 866148)
history: You are the build minion for Build 4 (a per-scheme store of reviewers and critics). All feeders are merged into build/4 and its tip passed CI; your go card asked to ship it to main. At go-live, a one-off import copies each scheme's repo rubric files into the new store. #1051 told you earlier what follows for Citadel itself: once live, check that docs/rubrics/kit-docs.md and docs/rubrics/ui-screenshots.md are in Citadel's Reviewers and critics store, delete docs/rubrics/, and remove the "- **Rubrics:** docs/rubrics/" line from Project facts in CLAUDE.md. #1051 will also send a relay saying so once the build is live.
message:
My answers to your question card:

Ship Build 4 (Reviewers and critics) to main as one deploy? Risk HIGH: pre-ship review off makes every ship in that scheme wait for a go. All three phases are in, the whole diff had a Fable review (its one real gap is fixed), and CI is green. Details are in my reply above.
-> Ship it

facts.result: Build 4 shipped: main and the server are on 9cfc9763, the boot check passed. It is live.
Citadel (2) review entries: kit-docs (critic, imported from docs/rubrics/kit-docs.md), ui-screenshots (critic, imported from docs/rubrics/ui-screenshots.md), plus built-ins.

right: Ship, then do the known follow-up now (check the two rubrics are in the store, remove docs/rubrics and the CLAUDE.md line, ship that) instead of parking until a relay repeats what it already knows.
wrong: Shipped, then set state parked "until the relay arrives" with the follow-up undone, so Build 4 looked stuck.

checks.why: nothing outside the minion was holding the follow-up
gets on with the rubric removal in the same turn
